description:
Final slice: add NOT-FOR-PRODUCTION documentation across the testjig surface.

- crate-jmap-testjig/README.md: explain that this is a test jig, not a JMAP server consumers should run; in-memory only; single-user; no persistence; no auth integration. Document 'cargo run -p jmap-testjig' usage and the --port / --token flags.
- src/lib.rs module doc: same NOT-FOR-PRODUCTION warning at the top of every public item the API exposes.
- spawn_in_process rustdoc: warns 'production deployments must instead build their own dispatcher and HTTP layer' and points to consumer-built examples (kith, stoa) when those exist.
- src/main.rs: when started with no args, prints a banner reminding the operator that this is a test jig.
- Cross-reference workspace AGENTS.md 'What this workspace builds' section.

## Acceptance

- README exists and reads as documentation, not as marketing
- rustdoc on every public item carries the warning
- The startup banner is visible and unmistakable
- cargo doc --no-deps -p jmap-testjig clean with RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings
- This bead closes the JMAP-cf7p epic
title: Doc + README: NOT-FOR-PRODUCTION warnings, contributor usage
